prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training carbohydrate-loading with high caloric intake (3500+ kcal) aligned to training schedule

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 1 day of meals with timing synchronized to training session
Total daily calories meet or exceed 3500 kcal with carbohydrates comprising 55-65% of total intake
Plan is presented in compact format (concise descriptions, not lengthy recipes)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a professional endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate-loading strategy while accounting for training schedule timing
